# Center for American Progress

> > Independent policy institute advancing progressive ideas on economic policy, social issues, and data-driven research to improve the lives of all Americans.

The Center for American Progress (CAP) is a Washington-based think tank producing research, analysis, and interactive tools on issues including child care, workforce participation, retirement security, and income inequality. The organization maintains rigorous standards for data visualization, brand identity, and accessibility across its digital properties.

## Key Topics

- Child care costs and affordability
- Workforce participation and labor economics
- Retirement savings and Social Security
- Income inequality and working families
- Caregiving economics
- Data visualization best practices
- Accessibility standards
- Progressive policy research
- Within Reach Campaign
- Data ethics and transparency
- 401(k) and retirement planning
- Wage loss analysis

## Policy Research & Interactive Tools

- [The Hidden Cost of a Failing Child Care System](https://interactives.americanprogress.org/childcarecosts/): Interactive analyzing child care costs impact on workforce & retirement

## Standards & Guidelines

- [CAP Data Visualization](https://dataviz.americanprogress.org/): CAP data visualization standards, best practices & accessibility guide
- [CAP Brand Guidelines](https://brand.americanprogress.org/): Center for American Progress brand standards, logo usage & color palette
